# Grok Marketplace fixtures

These fixtures preserve the Next.js Flight row structure and field paths captured from the public Marketplace on 2026-10-02. The index preserves the complete count (89), source identifiers, public slugs for the four editorially Featured listings, their placement, and the observed all-zero `installCount` values.

Descriptions, creator identifiers, and non-representative listing names/identifiers are sanitized. No fixture is generated by the parser and no fixture contains a package-private framing sentinel. Representative detail fixtures retain the public component shapes needed to exercise memories, skills, routines, integrations, and unavailable fields.
